register: Costing end-to-end closure: canonical issue register

issues.title: Tally source snapshot tables writable by any logged-in user
issues.business_consequence: Purchase, stock, issue and sales snapshots that drive material rates and allocation volumes can be inserted, changed or deleted by any authenticated user; approved-run inputs are not protected at source.
issues.reproduction: select tablename, policyname, cmd, roles, qual from pg_policies where schemaname='public' and tablename like 'tally%' and cmd in ('ALL','INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE');  -- 14 policies '<table>_authenticated_crud' ALL to authenticated, qual auth.uid() is not null
issues.expected_fix: Writes only via the ETL/service role (or a governed RPC); authenticated read-only. Prepare and test locally, confirm ETL writer identity first.
issues.tests: Local: authenticated INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE refused, service_role allowed, ETL path still works; live probe after approval.

issues.title: Internal material conversion is not an atomic column of the internal-loaded snapshot / cost sheet
issues.business_consequence: Displayed atomic components do not add up to internal loaded cost for 9 SKUs in run 128 (54,56,364,365,367,658,901,902,1285; 7 of them by >= Rs 0.01), which looked like 7/9 "prime anomalies". The cost itself is correct.
issues.reproduction: prime = material + direct labour + internal_material_conversion_cost (rpc_refresh_sku_prime_cost_snapshot); sku_internal_loaded_cost_snapshot has no IMC column.
issues.expected_fix: Carry internal_material_conversion_cost_per_sku through COP/ILC display, cost sheet lines and the G5 export (new runs only; no snapshot rewrite).
issues.tests: Identity: ILC = material + DL + IMC + PO + QC + stores + admin + finance admin for all SKUs (passes today when IMC is joined from prime).

issues.title: Central Office Charges Rs 8,71,972.83/month in admin pool from one FY25-26 year-end entry; overlap with HO admin Rs 5L/month unproven
issues.business_consequence: About 91% of the admin expense pool (Rs 9.56L) in runs 122 and 128 comes from this head; since Oct a further Rs 5L/month HO provision is added (admin pool Rs 16.71L). If both represent head-office cost, every SKU internal loaded cost is overstated.
issues.reproduction: ledger head 'Central Office Charges' policy_status CURRENT_METHOD_RETAINED, normal 871,972.83; recurring_cost_pool_provision id 1 HO_ADMIN_ALLOCATION 500,000 from 2026-10-01
issues.expected_fix: Obtain Tally voucher narrations / HO allocation note; set an approved normal; record the separation evidence.
issues.tests: Head-to-pool reconciliation; sensitivity of ILC for all SKUs to the two options.

issues.title: Cost-head ledger status counts in docs are stale
issues.business_consequence: Docs said 1 APPROVED / 40 PROVISIONAL / 5 UNRESOLVED / 6 EXCLUDED; live is 5 APPROVED / 38 PROVISIONAL / 1 CURRENT_METHOD_RETAINED / 8 EXCLUDED / 0 UNRESOLVED (52 rows). Decisions made on stale counts.
issues.reproduction: select policy_status, count(*) from costing.cost_head_policy_ledger where effective_to is null group by 1
issues.expected_fix: Status note added to COST_HEAD_POLICY_LEDGER.md; per-head table to be regenerated from live in G3.

issues.title: 38 provisional cost heads feed approved runs (all 16 marketing heads, Rs 29.6L/month)
issues.business_consequence: Approved costs depend on amounts not yet approved as normals; release requires a disposition per head.
issues.reproduction: see query
issues.expected_fix: Per-head disposition (approve normal / keep provisional with review date / exclude) in an approval packet.
issues.tests: Ledger has no PROVISIONAL head without a review date and owner.

issues.title: MATERIAL_LANDED_COST head (Rs 67,725 normal) is absorbed through the Materials-Stores overhead pool
issues.business_consequence: Stores pool expense Rs 73,343.53 = stores head Rs 5,618.53 + landed cost Rs 67,725. Landed cost is spread as stores overhead rather than added to material rates; per-SKU material cost excludes it.
issues.reproduction: compare ledger pool totals with cost_pool_monthly_snapshot MATERIALS_STORES_OVERHEAD
issues.expected_fix: Confirm the documented carriage-inward decision; if intended, label the component explicitly in the export.

issues.title: Workload pools route a small amount to internal source products and recover it through IMC
issues.business_consequence: Mfg direct labour, production OH, QC and stores pools appear short by Rs 175.26 (Oct) / Rs 1,600.75 (Sep) at SKU level; the amount is carried by internal intermediate products and returned exactly via internal material conversion. No loss or duplication.
issues.reproduction: sum(cost_per_sku * resolved_sales_units) per pool vs pool; sum(IMC * units)
issues.expected_fix: None. Keep as a golden conservation test.

issues.title: Regional (IK/OK) marketing conservation
issues.business_consequence: Rs 29,64,501.01 marketing pool fully allocated across IK and OK product-regions (share sum 1) in runs 122 and 128; 200 Oct rows REVIEW_REQUIRED (accepted assumptions).
issues.reproduction: see query
issues.expected_fix: None. Golden test.

issues.title: Fingerprint captures record no algorithm/schema version; table set differs by run
issues.business_consequence: Run 122 captures hash 50 tables, run 128 hash 51; the W5 method is recognisable only by the per-table "cols" key. Independent re-verification years later depends on knowing the exact table list and method.
issues.reproduction: select id, refresh_run_id, purpose, (select count(*) from jsonb_object_keys(fingerprint)) from costing.costing_run_fingerprint
issues.expected_fix: Add explicit algorithm_version and table-list hash to new captures (forward only; existing captures untouched).
issues.tests: Verify 122/128 = 0 drift before/after; new capture carries version.

issues.title: Capacity profiles: USER_DECLARED values are still flagged is_provisional
issues.business_consequence: 77 current profiles carry user-declared rated/working values but every one of the 298 rows is is_provisional=true, so measured values look like guesses; evidence confidence, approval and capacity purpose are conflated in one flag.
issues.reproduction: select evidence_type, is_provisional, count(*) from costing.plant_capacity_profile p where effective_to is null group by 1,2
issues.expected_fix: Separate fields: evidence_type (USER_DECLARED/NAME_DERIVED/NONE), approval_status, capacity_purpose (costing/planning-only), applicability; new appended versions, no edits.
issues.tests: Readiness view shows APPROVED_USER_DECLARED vs SCENARIO_PROVISIONAL distinctly.

issues.title: 74 production machines have no usable capacity (BLOCKED_NEEDS_CAPACITY)
issues.business_consequence: G4 plant-aware loads cannot be activated fail-closed while 74 capacity-based machines lack values; 20 more nulls are legitimately NOT_REQUIRED, 3 NOT_OPERATIONAL.
issues.reproduction: select readiness, count(*) from costing.v_plant_capacity_readiness group by 1
issues.expected_fix: Concise exception register of truly missing machine values (excluding ones already supplied), or explicit N/A / class-fallback approval.
issues.tests: Readiness counts; G4 isolated run shows no silent fallback.

issues.title: All capacity rows effective 1 Nov 2026; superseded rows use zero-length windows
issues.business_consequence: Nothing in the capacity master applies to October; R1/R2 supersessions are expressed as effective_from = effective_to = 2026-11-01. A prospective in-month use (mandate G2) needs a governed effective-date change.
issues.reproduction: select effective_from, effective_to, count(*) from costing.plant_capacity_profile group by 1,2
issues.expected_fix: Design the in-month prospective effective-date rule with supersession (no backdating); test on an isolated run.

issues.title: Machine 41 stone grinder: 2 kg vs 10 kg
issues.business_consequence: Current profile is 10 kg/charge (row 280, R2 user correction 18 Oct 18:19 IST); the 2 kg figure is the superseded R1 row 203. No conflict.
issues.reproduction: select * from costing.plant_capacity_profile where plant_id=41 order by id
issues.expected_fix: None.

issues.title: The 60% top-3 sales concentration rule is authoritative today (SALES-01), not a review flag
issues.business_consequence: Run 128 allocation bases for seasonal-flagged SKUs (e.g. 54, 56) use the 12-month average because top-3 months >= 0.60; DVS-1 (approved in principle) requires this to be only a diagnostic. No DVS-1 tables exist live, so promotional spikes, stockouts or institutional orders can be treated as seasonality.
issues.reproduction: select allocation_resolution_note, count(*) from costing.sku_sales_allocation_basis_snapshot where refresh_run_id=128 group by 1
issues.expected_fix: Build DVS-1 (G5 of AU-9) as a controlled migration: demand-pattern table, event register, governed overrides, selection snapshot; rule becomes REVIEW flag.
issues.tests: Sensitivity test; Kanji 878 June-Aug seasonal case; promotional spike fixture not classified seasonal.

issues.title: products.is_seasonal declares 15 of 1,342 products; not reconciled with rule-derived seasonal SKUs
issues.business_consequence: Business declaration and algorithmic classification can disagree silently.
issues.reproduction: select count(*) filter (where is_seasonal) from public.products
issues.expected_fix: Reconciliation table: declared vs rule vs DVS-1 decision.
issues.tests: Every seasonal SKU has a source.

issues.title: Repository migration records diverge from live
issues.business_consequence: Live has 582 applied migrations; the branch holds 96 files and main 90. 506 live-only (including all AU5-AU9, W1, W2, W5 costing migrations whose exact SQL is kept under docs/ evidence by rule), 20 repo-only names with different version stamps. A fresh environment cannot be rebuilt from the repo.
issues.reproduction: list_migrations vs supabase/migrations
issues.expected_fix: Migration parity register mapping each costing live version to its applied SQL file; decide whether to backfill supabase/migrations (after merge approval).
issues.tests: Parity script: every costing live version has a byte-identical SQL file in repo.

issues.title: 42 costing-related public views are SECURITY DEFINER (advisor ERROR)
issues.business_consequence: These views bypass row-level security; protection depends on the permission checks inside each view.
issues.reproduction: get_advisors(security) security_definer_view
issues.expected_fix: Audit each view for an app_has_permission gate; convert to security_invoker or add gate.

issues.title: 9 costing functions with mutable search_path
issues.business_consequence: Search-path hijack risk for definer functions.
issues.reproduction: advisor function_search_path_mutable
issues.expected_fix: Set search_path explicitly.

issues.title: 100 of 143 costing tables have RLS off; authenticated has costing USAGE and SELECT on 46 objects
issues.business_consequence: If the costing schema is exposed through the API, logged-in users can read run snapshots directly (no write grants found).
issues.reproduction: see g0_security.json
issues.expected_fix: Confirm API schema exposure; revoke SELECT or add RLS.

issues.title: Public W1 views carry full table ACL for authenticated via default privileges (C1)
issues.business_consequence: Views are not updatable, so no write effect; hygiene.
issues.reproduction: select relacl from pg_class where relname like %approved%
issues.expected_fix: Revoke to SELECT.

issues.title: Non-costing live migrations applied today 18:03-18:06 IST (lab_* x3), not in repo
issues.business_consequence: Another workstream changed live after W2; no costing/public definition changed (0 changed since the W2 install).
issues.reproduction: definition-hash diff vs evidence/W2/live_after_W2.json
issues.expected_fix: None for costing.

issues.title: Run 128 working price proposal is not finance-approved; Sheets and price revision suspended
issues.business_consequence: Do not present run-128 proposal as approved.
issues.expected_fix: None until G6 acceptance.

issues.title: Cron 60 (requester) and 61 (stage worker) paused; 61 is needed for any governed refresh
issues.business_consequence: No new run (e.g. November or a governed in-month revaluation) can complete without job 61.
issues.reproduction: select jobid, active from cron.job where jobid in (60,61)
issues.expected_fix: Decide restore window for 61; keep 60 paused.
issues.tests: Job 61 run log during approved window.

issues.title: 9 negative-margin SKUs and 37 REVIEW_REQUIRED SKUs in approved Oct run 128
issues.business_consequence: SKUs 42,43,159,193,975,1174,1264,1365,1552 negative (IK and OK); 37 cost sheets REVIEW_REQUIRED; need disposition before release.
issues.reproduction: select sku_id from costing.v_price_revision_feed_approved where period_start=2026-10-01 and (ik_negative_margin or ok_negative_margin)
issues.expected_fix: Per-SKU trace (cost level) and disposition.

issues.title: Margin basis vs pricing_cost_per_sku
issues.business_consequence: Margins are MRP - (ILC + regional marketing IK/OK) (627/627 verified); pricing_cost_per_sku uses national marketing and never matches the margin. Consumers may misread.
issues.reproduction: ik_margin = mrp_ik - pricing_cost_per_sku_ik
issues.expected_fix: Label clearly in G5 export.

issues.title: Cost waterfall identities (runs 122 and 128)
issues.business_consequence: All SKUs (634 Sep, 627 Oct): material = RM + PM; prime = material + DL + IMC; DL = mfg DL + packing; COP = prime + PO + QC + stores; ILC = COP + admin + finance admin; bridge ILC = ILC; pricing costs and margins. Head-to-pool: ledger totals = frozen pool expense for all 7 pools.
issues.reproduction: see SQL
issues.expected_fix: None; adopt as golden tests (G6).

issues.title: Upstream lineage not yet traced (Tally rates -> material lines; BOM/UOM/yield; route/machine loads; HR roles)
issues.business_consequence: Downstream arithmetic is proven; the correctness of inputs (rates, quantities, batch sizes, staffing) is not yet independently traced for sample SKUs.
issues.expected_fix: Lineage map A + sample SKU traces at each level (high-risk set incl. 9 negatives, kit 865, Kanji 878).
